UE426_MEANING.MemoryMaxUsedPhysical: Target maximum physical memory (working set) for the cook process. Cooker attempts to throttle memory usage to stay below this. NOT a hard limit - cook can exceed.
UE426_MEANING.MemoryMinFreePhysical: Minimum free physical memory to maintain system-wide. Cooker will throttle if system free memory drops below this.
UE426_MEANING.MemoryMaxUsedVirtual: Maximum virtual memory (commit) for cook process. 0 = unlimited (no virtual memory throttling).
UE426_MEANING.MemoryMinFreeVirtual: Minimum free virtual memory (commit) system-wide. 0 = no limit.

THROTTLING_ANALYSIS.cook_throttles_at_16GiB: PARTIAL - UE4 cooker monitors working set and may delay package processing, but ShaderCompileWorkers (separate processes) are NOT accounted in cook process memory.
THROTTLING_ANALYSIS.SCWs_excluded_from_accounting: YES - ShaderCompileWorker processes are spawned separately and their memory is NOT included in the cook process memory accounting. Each SCW can use 1-4+ GB.
THROTTLING_ANALYSIS.commit_can_exceed_policy: YES - MemoryMaxUsedVirtual=0 means no virtual memory limit. Current UE4Editor commit is 11.6 GB, SCWs add more. System commit limit is 56.7 GB.
THROTTLING_ANALYSIS.worker_processes_bypass_accounting: YES - SCW memory is invisible to cook memory policy. With 4 workers at ~2-4 GB each, total SCW memory = 8-16 GB additional.

OOM_RISK_ASSESSMENT.prior_oom_cause: Likely SCW memory + UE4Editor commit exceeding system commit limit or physical memory pressure
OOM_RISK_ASSESSMENT.current_risk: MODERATE - 19.7 GB free physical, but SCWs + UE4Editor + OS + other processes could pressure. Pagefile only 9 GB.
OOM_RISK_ASSESSMENT.mitigation_in_place: DevOptions.Shaders.NumUnusedShaderCompilingThreads=8 (limits SCW count to 4 active per log)
